text:
maya: Heads up — security scan flagged a public token in one of the shared Jupyter workspaces. looks like a notebook cell printed a long-lived PAT earlier today.
kevin: omg. which workspace?
lina: timeline? did it go out to any public logs?
maya: workspace: team-analytics-prod-notebooks. flagged at 12:14 UTC by our log scanner. there were a few S3 presigned links in outputs.
devsec-bot: ALERT: detected potential secret exposure in workspace team-analytics-prod-notebooks (rule: notebook-output-secret). first-seen: 1851200200. severity: high.
kevin: immediate actions we should take: 1) revoke any long-lived tokens used in that workspace 2) snapshot & quarantine the workspace 3) run a search for presigned urls and blob downloads 4) rotate affected service creds.
maya: agreed. i'm going to revoke the workspace ephemeral tokens and disable public sharing now.
notebook-admin: running revoke script on workspace team-analytics-prod-notebooks now — ETA ~3m. cmd: ```/opt/notebook-admin/revoke_token --workspace team-analytics-prod-notebooks --revoke-all```
ops-bot: revoke job started (job_id: rj-29384).
kevin: lina / terra can you help identify which users ran that notebook in last 7 days and ask them to rotate tokens?
lina: pulling execution history — give me 2m.
terra: I'll post on the #team-analytics channel once we confirm which users. pls include the exact steps they need to take to rotate.
maya: quick checklist for devs: - stop running notebooks in that workspace - rotate personal PATs and any service keys they used - purge outputs with presigned urls - run `scripts/notebook-scan --workspace team-analytics-prod-notebooks` and paste results here
kevin: infra action: enable workspace network egress block until we finish triage. set firewall to internal-only.
ops-bot: egress policy applied to team-analytics-prod-notebooks (rule: block-external-http).
notebook-admin: revoke finished. all workspace user session tokens invalidated. created support ticket #INC-6291 to track artifact preservation.
lina: users who ran notebooks in last 7 days: @jjohns, @sarah, @anil. pinging them now.
jjohns: confirmed i ran it. rotating my PAT and deleting the notebook cell. will re-run scan.
sarah: same here. looks like I had an accidental `display(url)` call. rotating creds.
anil: I used a presigned link to pull data earlier, rotating keys and re-uploading.
maya: good. please paste rotation confirmation here and the `notebook-scan` output.
jjohns: scan output: ```FOUND: presigned-url s3://redwood-analytics/temp/abc123?X-Amz-... location: /notebooks/analysis.ipynb cell 34```
kevin: service creds: running rotation for the ETL role now. command: ```gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete KEY_ID && gcloud iam service-accounts keys create --iam-account=etl-sa@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com```
ops-bot: ETL service account key rotation initiated.
devsec-bot: NOTE: as a mitigation we'll enforce the notebook hardening policy: no cell outputs saved that contain URLs; disable presigned url creation except through vetted libs. policy rollout in progress.
maya: longer term policy changes (action items): - enforce ephemeral credentials for notebooks (OIDC) within 2 weeks - enable automated output scrubbing for URLs - require workspace-level egress controls by default - add a pre-commit hook to the notebook CI to run `notebook-scan` - training + incident postmortem
kevin: owners: infra (kevin) for egress & SA rotation, notebooks (notebook-admin) for token revokes & policy flags, sec (maya) for postmortem and communication.
lina: i've uploaded the execution history and artifacts to the incident ticket INC-6291.
terra: posting an org-wide advisory draft in #all-hands after sec reviews. will include instructions for rotating PATs and checking workspaces.
maya: timeline note: detected 12:14 UTC, revoke done 12:18 UTC, egress block 12:22 UTC.
kevin: confirm: are there any external downloads logged from that workspace?
notebook-admin: download logs: 3 presigned-s3 GETs to external buckets between 11:30-12:05 UTC. bucket owners differ — flagged S3 external access.
kevin: opening support requests to those bucket owners; also adding audits.
jjohns: confirmed my PAT rotated at 12:27 UTC. scan now clean for me.
anil: rotated service key 12:31 UTC and re-uploaded dataset under private presigned policy.
sarah: rotated at 12:28 UTC.
maya: thank you. postmortem owners: maya + kevin. please draft by EOD tomorrow with remediation and follow-ups.
devsec-bot: REMINDER: scheduled policy enforcement job (notebook-hardening) will start in 14 days for the initial pilot group.
terra: copying this thread into #team-analytics and #eng-security for visibility.
kevin: one more: we'll add an automated alert rule so any workspace that creates presigned urls triggers an immediate soft-revoke and paging to sec oncall.
maya: finished for now. if anyone finds additional exposures, paste them here. :lock: :warning:
ops-bot: INCIDENT INC-6291 updated: status=mitigated, severity=high, owners=[maya,kevin], followups=[postmortem, policy-rollout].
kevin: thanks everyone. appreciate the quick responses.
maya: good job all — we'll follow up with a summary and org-wide guidance after the postmortem.
